=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4037-4039 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-step budget formula ("pre-sleep + cap + watch deadline + margin") in the step comments and in tests/test_dispatch_and_watch_rate_limit.py `test_gate_dispatch_steps_fit_rate_limit_cap_in_step_budget` leaves out the PRE_RUN_ID lookup at scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:730, whose gh_api_safe backoff is 30+60+120 = 210 s (scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:134-147). It also leaves out the up-to-20 s `timeout 20 gh api rate_limit` read for each wait.
  WHY: The update_workflows worst case is about 1224-1244 s, more than the 1080 s step timeout, and validation-refresh is about 5844-5864 s, more than 5700 s. GitHub can kill the step during the watch, so the #9532 timeout-cancel block (lines 4074-4100) never runs and the child run is orphaned. The contract test encodes the same incomplete formula, so it cannot catch this. All reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4039 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The update_workflows rate-limit cap DISPATCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS: "410" is shorter than the incident's ~510 s wait (505 s to the reset + 5 s margin).
  WHY: An exact replay hits the cap-reached logic in scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh (lines 196-200), logs outcome=cap_reached and fails the dispatch instead of waiting for the reset. The reviewer rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:196-201 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cap check is correct on its own, but the workflow caps (410 for update_workflows; 110, 230, 240 and 180 for the others) are all below the 510 s incident wait. With `410 < 0+510` the check trips on attempt 1, logs `outcome=cap_reached` and fails before `sleep "${rl_wait}"` runs.
  WHY: Replaying the 03:14:38 403 with the 03:23:03 reset fails acceptance criterion #1 for the incident step. `test_primary_rate_limit_replay_waits_for_reset_then_dispatches` only covers the default cap of 1500. The reviewer rated it BLOCKER (mapped to critical). This shares a root cause with the yml:4039 finding above but cites a different file, so it is listed separately.
- scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:197-200 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the cap is reached on the first attempt, the cap-reached branch prints `::error::gh workflow run <file> failed after ${DISPATCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts` ("failed after 5 attempts"), even though only one `gh workflow run` was tried.
  WHY: The log contradicts itself (the `DISPATCH_RATE_LIMIT_WAIT outcome=cap_reached` line shows `waited_total_s=0`, `dispatches=1`), which misleads operators. The issue asked to keep this line, so the behaviour is by design. The reviewer rated it NIT (mapped to low).
- PR description body:"Known gap: the incident step's 420-second cap still fails that exact replay." | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The PR description says the cap is "420-second", but `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4039` sets `DISPATCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS: "410"`.
  WHY: Reviewers and operators copy numbers from the PR description, so the wrong value makes the "known gap" harder to check against the YAML. The reviewer rated it NIT (mapped to low).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Acceptance criterion 1: "Replaying the evidence (403 rate limit at 03:14:38, reset at 03:23:03) ends in a successful dispatch after one wait of about 8.5 minutes." Goal: "A dispatch that fails on a rate limit waits for the reset and then goes through, within a bounded time, instead of failing the job."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, step "Dispatch & watch — update_workflows (allow_workflow_edits=false)" (lines 4032-4068; cap `DISPATCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS: "410"` at lines 4037-4039), with the cap check at scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:196-201. The same budget split applies at lines 3941-3943, 4122-4124, 4301-4303 and 4746-4748.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The incident wait is 505 s + 5 s = 510 s, more than the 410 cap, so the check at scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh:196-200 logs outcome=cap_reached and returns 1 without waiting. Every gate cap (110, 410, 230, 240, 180) is below 510 s. test_primary_rate_limit_replay_waits_for_reset_then_dispatches uses only the 1500 s default cap. The changelog fragment, README and PR comment acknowledge the gap, but no follow-up issue is declared. Suggested in-PR fix: subtract the rate-limit time already spent from the watch deadlines, or re-anchor them on the dispatch. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER (minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna) vs MAJOR (others).
- requirement: Acceptance criterion 3: "The full test suite passes."
  expected_change_site: PR validation / pre-push test gate (PR description's "Pre-push test gate" section)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

There is no passing full-suite result for this head. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly chose not to report this, because the failures are attributed to the merge-base.
- requirement: The PR description should accurately state the cap the diff introduces ("the incident step's 420-second cap still fails that exact replay").
  expected_change_site: PR description body (the actual value is at .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4039)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:lines 4037-4039 (also 3941-3943, 4122-4124, 4746-4748; tests/test_dispatch_and_watch_rate_limit.py test_gate_dispatch_steps_fit_rate_limit_cap_in_step_budget) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The step budget leaves out the PRE_RUN_ID lookup at scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh line 730. That lookup uses gh_api_safe_quiet_print with the GH_PAT token (line 3860) and backs off 30, 60 and 120 s = 210 s (scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh lines 134-147). The budget also leaves out the 20 s rate_limit read and the time of the `gh workflow run` call.
  WHY: COMPLETION_DEADLINE is anchored at DISPATCH_STARTED_AT (script lines 753 and 818). The worst case is about 1224-1244 s against 1080 s, so the #9532 cancel block (lines 4074-4100) never runs. validation-refresh: 5844 s > 5700 s. Fix: add the backoff and read time to the formula and lower the caps, or start counting the cap before the PRE_RUN_ID lookup.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: AC1 "Replaying the evidence (403 rate limit at 03:14:38, reset at 03:23:03) ends in a successful dispatch after one wait of about 8.5 minutes."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, step "Dispatch & watch — update_workflows (allow_workflow_edits=false)" (lines 4032-4068), cap "410" at line 4039.
  Evidence of absence: The ~510 s wait is more than the 410 cap, so line 196 trips and lines 197-200 return cap_reached. Every cap is below 510 s (110, 410, 230, 240, 180). The replay test uses the default cap of 1500 s. No follow-up is declared. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
- HARDENING: scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh lines 739-741 / 756-762. The registration window is fixed before dispatch_workflow, which can now sleep up to the cap. When PRE_RUN_ID_LOOKUP_OK=false, the fallback query `created=>${REGISTRATION_WINDOW_FALLBACK_UTC}` with `sort_by(.created_at) | last` can pick another run created during the wait. Fix: record DISPATCH_LAST_ATTEMPT_EPOCH before each `gh workflow run` and recompute the fallback epoch and UTC (~4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
